typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ {U : Finset.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)},
      DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.IsFlow N U →
        ∀ (S : Finset.{0} ν),
          Membership.mem.{0, 0} S (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.s N) →
            DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.t N ∉ S →
              Eq.{1} (∑ x ∈ S, DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.outdeg U x)
                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (∑ x ∈ S, DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.indeg U x)
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.value N U))

source.code:
/-- Flow conservation summed over an `s`–`t` cut. -/
theorem sum_cut (hN : N.Ok) {U : Finset (ν × ν)} (hU : N.IsFlow U) (S : Finset ν)
    (hs : N.s ∈ S) (ht : N.t ∉ S) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, outdeg U x = ∑ x ∈ S, indeg U x + N.value U := by
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S _ hs, ← Finset.add_sum_erase S _ hs, N.indeg_s_eq_zero hN hU]
  have : ∑ x ∈ S.erase N.s, outdeg U x = ∑ x ∈ S.erase N.s, indeg U x := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_erase] at hx
    exact (hU.cons x hx.1 (fun h => ht (h ▸ hx.2))).symm
  unfold value
  omega
